questions: What is the rate?
If the rate goes up, do you get there sooner?
What is inventory?
If inventory goes unsold tonight, can it be sold tomorrow?
What is yield?
When yield rises, do you have more to sell?
Who counts as a guest?
If a guest leaves early, is the space free right away?
What is turnover?
When turnover rises, do you need to hire replacements?
What is a table?
If a table is turned, is it ready for use again?
What is a channel?
If a channel goes dark, can customers still buy?
What is a queue?
If the queue clears, is everyone already served?
What is a no-show?
If a no-show is recorded, was the space unused?
What is a comp?
If a comp is approved, does someone still pay?
What is a program?
When the program ends, is there nothing left to do?
What is an allocation?
If the allocation runs out, can another request still be accepted?
What is a display?
If the display is taken down, can customers still find what it showed?
What is the margin?
If the margin is reduced, is there more space available?
What is a hold?
If a hold expires, is the space still reserved?
